Guidance & outlook: Sir my question was regarding in your presentation there it was vision 5000 targeting the INR 5,000 crores revenue.
So, we are targeting the revenue from different segments, which will be crossing from 500 crores to 1,000 crores in each segment.

Apart from that, from the master system integration business which we are doing within Government of India, another 1,000 crores worth of target we are planning to achieve when it comes towards the area of down the line in next 5 years.
Growth & demand: If I'll bifurcate the revenue which we have achieved in H1 amongst each company starting from parent to all our subsidiaries, the bifurcation of the percentage of revenue upgrade Sahana System Limited November 17, 2025 from existing customers as well as new client would be for Sahana as a standalone, we have achieved 76% of the revenue from our existing cust…

If I'll talk about Softvan, which is majorly working into our deep-tech and defense ecosystem, we have achieved the existing revenue of 65% out of our existing customers, and the new client acquisitions were 35%, which was a tremendous growth and that was projected even at the beginning of this year.
Parallelly for Sourceved and Softvan Lab, we have acquired more than 12% to 15% new customers when it comes towards the revenue growth aspect of it.
Margins & costs: So, let us say I mean if you look at the last year's revenue, which we have booked was INR167 crores with the EBITDA of 34% and PAT of 23%.
This year, if you look at the H1 result, the consolidated revenue the company has achieved so far is INR114 crores, where our EBITDA has been 33% and our PAT has increased 1 more percent to 24%.
So overall aspect of the margin, sir, eventually in defense ecosystem, the margin will get increased.
Capex & expansion: Now when we talk about the key marquee customers, which we acquired, I mean if we look at the H1 result of the group, I'll name couple of good customers whom we acquired within this particular period.
In parallel to that when we talk about our footprint in edutech, we have also acquired good marquee customers into edutech ecosystem and we have grown there well.
And we have also acquired, I mean, apart from the planned growth, which was there, we have also acquired couple of large-scale projects.
Balance sheet & cash: And for that, I think, I was watching your cash flow and it is on negative side.
So I am hoping that probably you have high working capital.
So, when we speak about electronic warfare, information warfare and defense business, the business is -- if it is more product-driven, then the cash flow intensity will be less.
Risks & challenges: Sahana System Limited November 17, 2025 But any kind of risk that, you see that, something might not click or any, in general, because we are in multiple verticals.
After considering and after doing the risk assessment, the numbers which has been given so far as the projection are conservative.
So that's the only strategic -- I would not call it risk, but strategic challenge which will come whenever any such opportunity comes into play.
